cited.basis:
The same Gospel, Matthew 21, 1-9, in a different place in the service. In the
pre-1955 witnesses it is read before the blessing prayers
(missale-romanum-1920 32017-32022, pustet-1862 28242-28247); in the 1962 witness
it stands after the distribution of palms, under its own heading DE LECTIONE
EVANGELICA (benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 34784, 34800-34805).
